fusions.name: Ballast Blow
fusions.desc: Brings an iron ballast weight down on an enemy, dealing 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaving it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Wallowing Wash
fusions.desc: Rolls your weight through the water around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Becalmed
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to still everything within 4 tiles, holding every creature there in place for 3 seconds and leaving them 30% slower for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Outlast It
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions lifts, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
